transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, next week we need to recertify our Alpha and Bravo vehicle-operator cohorts. We've got two four-hour blocks available in the training area: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. Each cohort needs its own evaluator, and that evaluator has to be listed on the training schedule. Before I publish the final schedule, I want to make sure we get all our coordination sorted out in this huddle. What do we need to work through to get this locked in?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the training database this morning — the only evaluator currently authorized for the Alpha cohort is Sgt. Lewis, and he's available Monday 0800-1200. The evaluator roster hasn't been attached to the weekly schedule yet, so we need to make sure Sgt. Lewis gets listed on the schedule for that block.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical for the schedule. I confirmed the bay booking today — Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning. That means Bravo cohort can only train during the Tuesday 1300-1700 block, after motor pool release. The maintenance calendar hasn't been cross-referenced with the training schedule yet, so if Bravo gets slotted for Monday, we'll have a conflict.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.bravo_vehicle_release_condition: Bravo cohort trains Tuesday 1300-1700 only after motor pool releases the vehicles from preventive maintenance; Bravo vehicles are booked for PM Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning.

commitments.detail: Capt. Morgan will publish the final training schedule listing Sgt. Lewis as the Alpha evaluator for Monday 0800-1200 and the Bravo evaluator for Tuesday 1300-1700, with the evaluator roster attached.
Ensure the maintenance calendar is cross-referenced with the training schedule so Bravo's PM bookings (Monday afternoon, Tuesday morning) are reflected and no conflict is created.
Attach the evaluator roster to the weekly training schedule before publication, ensuring Sgt. Lewis is listed for the Alpha block.
